metaData.originalTitle: 从个人提速到团队提效：小米 AI Coding 工程化实践
metaData.title: From Individual Acceleration to Team Efficiency: Xiaomi's AI Coding Engineering Practices
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Xiaomi's retail R&D team shares three layers of engineering practices for transitioning from individual AI coding acceleration to team-wide efficiency: the unified workflow VAF, the code knowledge base VKF, and the collaboration workstation eight-claw, with the core focus on lowering barriers, consolidating knowledge, and achieving process transparency.
metaData.summary: This article, authored by Xiaomi's technical team, systematically elaborates on the bottlenecks and solutions encountered after scaling AI coding engineering to hundreds of people. It points out that improvements in individual coding efficiency do not directly translate into organizational efficiency gains. The real bottlenecks lie in the loss during requirement translation, delays in decision feedback loops, and the scattering of context across terminals. To address this, the team built three layers of engineering practices: The first layer is the unified workflow VAF (Vibe Agentic Flow), which lowers the barrier to AI usage through a menu-driven, low-threshold process, enabling even developers unfamiliar with AI to get started, and introduces a convergence coordination pattern to support multi-service collaboration. The second layer is the code knowledge base VKF (Vibe Knowledge Flow). After the failure of VKF 1.0, which attempted to translate code into documentation, the team repositioned it as a knowledge index for code, helping AI find entry points and critical paths in real code faster and more accurately, rather than replacing the code itself. The third layer is the collaboration workstation eight-claw, an AI collaboration bot built within Feishu. It uses 'topics' as the smallest governance unit for parallel execution, making the AI's work process transparent within the team's collaboration space, thus solving the problems of information opacity and parallel collaboration. The article concludes by distilling four design principles and emphasizes that the accumulation of knowledge and collaboration is the organizational capability hardest to replicate in the AI era.

mainPoints.point: The core bottleneck of AI engineering is organizational collaboration, not individual productivity.
mainPoints.explanation: As individual coding speed increases, requirement translation, decision feedback delays, and scattered context become more prominent obstacles. Improving team efficiency requires solving the problem of information loss during its flow within the organization.

mainPoints.point: Lowering the barrier to AI adoption is more important than pushing the upper limit of AI capability.
mainPoints.explanation: The overall capability of a team is determined by the 80% majority. By using standardized workflows like VAF with menus, developers unfamiliar with AI can use it reliably, enabling scaled efficiency gains.

mainPoints.point: A code knowledge base should serve as an index, not a substitute explanation for the code.
mainPoints.explanation: The VKF 1.0 attempt to translate code into documentation failed due to precision loss. VKF 2.0 was repositioned as a knowledge directory and index for code, helping AI find key locations in real code faster, rather than replacing the code itself.

mainPoints.point: The AI work process must be integrated into the team's collaboration space to achieve process transparency.
mainPoints.explanation: By embedding AI tasks as 'topics' in Feishu via eight-claw, the decision-making process, execution status, and outputs become visible to the team, solving the problems of parallel collaboration and information opacity.

mainPoints.point: The accumulation of knowledge and collaboration is the most critical organizational asset in the AI era.
mainPoints.explanation: Toolchains and models will iterate rapidly, but the explicit, structured knowledge accumulated by a team in a specific business domain, along with records of the collaboration process, provide long-term benefits and are difficult to replicate.

keyQuotes: With AI, every individual developer has become faster, but the organization has not.
AI not being smart enough is not the bottleneck; getting people to use it first is. Lowering the barrier is more important than raising the ceiling.
Giving AI more code is less effective than giving it a knowledge index. A knowledge index is more important than code ingestion.
It's not enough for everyone to use AI well; parallel collaboration and process transparency are the keys to organizational efficiency.
Toolchains will evolve; knowledge and collaboration are what endure.

relatedArticles.title: Xiaomi MiMo Reveals Full-Stack Optimization Details of Its Model Inference System for the First Time
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Xiaomi has publicly disclosed the full-stack optimization scheme for its MiMo-V2.5 series model inference system for the first time. Centered around the Hybrid SWA + MoE + multimodal architecture, it systematically restructures KVCache management, prefix caching, scheduling strategies, and the Prefill/Decode pipeline, compressing KVCache storage to approximately 1/7, thereby supporting a permanent API price reduction of up to 99%.

relatedArticles.title: Harness Engineering: Can AI Write Code in Truly "Mission-Critical" Backend Systems?
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article shares the complete methodology—Harness Engineering—practiced by Tencent's CDN LEGO team for AI coding in ultra-large-scale, high-reliability backend systems. Through a five-layer architecture, three key levers (context, constraints, feedback), and multi-model adversarial code review, they built an engineering system that enables AI to safely and controllably produce high-quality code.

relatedArticles.title: Xiaomi's New Tech Breakthrough! Xiaomi OneVL Autonomous Driving Model Officially Released and Fully Open-Sourced
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Xiaomi officially released and fully open-sourced the Xiaomi OneVL one-step latent space language-vision reasoning framework, which surpasses explicit CoT in accuracy while matching answer-only prediction in speed, marking the first unification of VLA, world models, and latent space reasoning.

relatedArticles.title: Lei Jun: New Generation SU7 Officially Launched, Latest Xiaomi AI Progress, and Multiple Major New Products
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Lei Jun officially launched the new generation Xiaomi SU7, highlighting comprehensive upgrades in exterior design, chassis performance, smart cockpit, and the assisted driving system powered by the Xiaomi XLA cognitive large model.

relatedArticles.title: Why Software Becomes Increasingly Complex: A Deep Dive into Software 'Complexity'
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article deeply analyzes the causes and manifestations of software complexity through e-commerce case studies, contrasts tactical and strategic programming, and systematically proposes practical methodologies for managing complexity via deep module design, information hiding, and proper abstraction.

relatedArticles.title: The Evolution of Agent/Skills/Teams Architectures and Principles of Technology Selection
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically reviews the evolutionary trajectory of AI Agents from monolithic to multi-agent, then to Skills pluginization and Teams parallel collaboration, and, drawing on the latest research from Google and Anthropic, provides a scientific methodology for selection.

relatedArticles.title: A Practical Guide to 'Progressive Spec' for AI Coding in 2026
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article proposes a 'Progressive Spec' framework for AI coding environments, leveraging structured documentation to drive AI collaboration and balance development standards with execution efficiency.

relatedArticles.title: From Correct Installation to Optimal Use: Xiaomi Air Conditioner's AI Engineering Practice
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details how Xiaomi's air conditioner team leverages AI vision to verify installation compliance, deep reinforcement learning for energy-saving control, and intelligent diagnostics for clogged filters and refrigerant shortages, embedding AI across the entire lifecycle of installation, operation, and maintenance, while distilling a reusable engineering methodology.

relatedArticles.title: Harness Engineering: How I Spent a Week Boosting AI Coding Rate to 90% in an Enterprise App
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article systematically introduces Harness Engineering, a new AI coding paradigm that elevates the AI code rate of an enterprise Java application from 25% to over 90% by building a four-element system of rules, skills, knowledge, and change management.

relatedArticles.title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Pro Launch: A Flagship Foundation Model for the Agent Era
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Xiaomi has released its flagship foundation model, MiMo-V2-Pro, tailored for Agent scenarios. It features 1T parameters, a 1M context window, cost-effective API pricing, and deep integration within the Xiaomi and Kingsoft Office ecosystems.
